permission.title: How much should Kun do on its own?
permission.subtitle: Decide whether Kun asks you before it runs commands or changes files.
permission.fullNote: Kun will edit files, run commands and use the network without asking each time. For unfamiliar repositories or outside input, switch to "Ask for approval" from the permission menu in the composer.
permission.otherNote: This is the default for new tasks. Each task can switch it from the permission menu in the composer.
permission.declined: You did not confirm "{{picked}}", so Kun keeps "{{kept}}". Pick it again and save to change it.
permission.saveHint: Saving starts Kun and checks the connection

agents.emptyBody: Install Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI, then choose Detect again. You can also skip this and add them later in Settings › Agent center.
